# Obsidian Tavern

> A creative writing and worldbuilding hub featuring original fictional worlds, serialized stories, educational courses, and an active community of writers and worldbuilders.

Obsidian Tavern serves as both a platform for publishing original speculative fiction across multiple interconnected worlds (Mudwick, The Thin Hours, Blankfall, Concrete, Contact, and Pocket) and an educational resource offering comprehensive guides on worldbuilding, magic systems, character development, and writing craft. The site combines community engagement, creative content, and instructional materials for aspiring and experienced writers.

## Key Topics

- Mudwick
- The Thin Hours
- Worldbuilding
- Magic Systems
- Character Development
- Serialized Fiction
- Fantasy Writing
- Story Structure
- Speculative Fiction
- Writing Guides
- Blankfall
- The Culling
- Paranormal Abilities
- Time-Loop
- Creative Writing Community

## Fictional Worlds

- [Explore Worlds](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore): Directory of fictional worlds including Mudwick, Blankfall, Concrete, and The Thin Hours
- [Mudwick](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore/mudwick): Mudwick fantasy world with paranormal abilities and young adult serialized fiction
- [The Thin Hours](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore/the-thin-hours): The Thin Hours world featuring 3:33 time-loop and parallel worlds stories
- [Blankfall](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore/blankfall): Blankfall world exploration featuring The Last Copy serialized stories
- [Contact](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore/contact): Contact world featuring The Contact Failure Trilogy sci-fi series
- [Concrete](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore/concrete): Concrete world with survival fiction and interactive story collection
- [Pocket Dimensions](https://obsidiantavern.com/explore/pocket): Pocket dimensions world with serialized fantasy and speculative fiction

## Serialized Stories & Publications

- [Mudwick Tales Vol I](https://obsidiantavern.com/stories/mudwick-tales-vol-i): Mudwick short story collection featuring characters with saturation paranormal powers
- [Book I: The Culling](https://obsidiantavern.com/stories/book-i-the-culling): Mudwick young adult fantasy excerpt featuring hidden school and paranormal abilities
- [3:33 - Book 1](https://obsidiantavern.com/stories/333-book-1): The Thin Hours supernatural serialized story with time anomalies and parallel worlds
- [Please - Echo](https://obsidiantavern.com/stories/please): Free psychological horror story collection featuring paranormal audio abilities
- [Blog](https://obsidiantavern.com/blog): Blog featuring articles on worldbuilding, magic systems, and writing guides

## Writing & Worldbuilding Guides

- [Worldbuilding](https://obsidiantavern.com/worldbuilding): Worldbuilding guides and articles covering fantasy worldbuilding and story structure
- [Fantasy & Sci-Fi Writing](https://obsidiantavern.com/fantasy-sci-fi-writing): Writing advice and guides for fantasy and sci-fi with focus on craft and magic systems
- [Magic Systems](https://obsidiantavern.com/magic-systems): Guide to designing magic systems with rules, limitations, and story mechanics
- [Character Development](https://obsidiantavern.com/character-development): Character creation and development guide using Tuesday Test and Reality Anchor Method

## Courses & Learning

- [Courses - Master Worldbuilding & Writing](https://obsidiantavern.com/courses-catalog): Course catalog including The WorldBuilder's Grimoire and Obsidian for World-Builders

## Community & Publications

- [Community - Join Writers & Worldbuilders](https://obsidiantavern.com/community): Community hub with writing groups, word wars, and sprints for writers
- [Books](https://obsidiantavern.com/books): Book store featuring Mudwick series and Tavern Tales bundles for purchase
